comment: Licenses allowed for every NuGet package (src and tests) and every non-dev npm package in site/. Anything else fails CI unless a scoped exception below allows it. No fee-bearing or source-available terms (SPEC §E). Files vendored into the site (fonts, map geometry) are listed under "vendored" with their SHA-256 and license text; their licenses come from "vendored_allowed".
